async def simulate(*, sim, tasks, vars):
    result = await sim.run(tasks['axial'])
    await sim.record('axial_displacement', result["artifacts"]['displacement'])
    await sim.record('axial_reaction', result["artifacts"]['reaction'])
    await sim.record('axial_stress', result["artifacts"]['stress'])
    await sim.record('axial_stressField', result["artifacts"]['stressField'])
    sim.release(result["artifacts"])
    sim.release(result["state"])
    result = await sim.run(tasks['bending'])
    await sim.record('bending_displacement', result["artifacts"]['displacement'])
    await sim.record('bending_reaction', result["artifacts"]['reaction'])
    await sim.record('bending_stress', result["artifacts"]['stress'])
    await sim.record('bending_stressField', result["artifacts"]['stressField'])
    sim.release(result["artifacts"])
    sim.release(result["state"])
    result = await sim.run(tasks['torsion'])
    await sim.record('torsion_displacement', result["artifacts"]['displacement'])
    await sim.record('torsion_reaction', result["artifacts"]['reaction'])
    await sim.record('torsion_stress', result["artifacts"]['stress'])
    await sim.record('torsion_stressField', result["artifacts"]['stressField'])
    sim.release(result["artifacts"])
    sim.release(result["state"])
